description: Construction of a building ranging in height from 6 to 15 storeys, to provide builders merchants (Use Class Sui Generis) at ground and first floor level, and 185 self-contained residential units (Use Class C3) and associated amenity space above; hard and soft landscaping works; provision of car and cycle parking; works to provide means of access for both pedestrians and vehicles from Horn Lane and all other works incidental to the development. (Following demolition of existing builders merchants)
